meta.source: All user-uploaded medal, award, race, and event photos available in the August 11, 2026 project conversation
meta.privacy: The private uploaded image files are not stored in the public repository. This file records only facts and research cues extracted from them.
meta.policy: A photo or medal may establish event identity, year, distance, challenge participation, award, or location. Official timing data remains preferred for time/place; photo evidence is not used to invent a finish when cancellation, registration-only distribution, or virtual participation is possible.
